# `aitbc system file`

Read a remote AITBC configuration, log, or data file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc system file [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | text | — | yes | Absolute path to a file under /opt/aitbc, /etc/aitbc, /etc/systemd, /var/log/aitbc, or /var/lib/aitbc |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc system file --path <path>
```
